FUEL TECH REPORTS 2026 THIRD QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS; OUTLINES FRAMEWORK FOR SUSTAINABLE GROWTH AND VALUE CREATION

 

WARRENVILLE, Ill., - November 3, 2026 – Fuel Tech, Inc. (NASDAQ: FTEK), a technology company using advanced engineering processes to provide emissions control systems and water treatment technologies in utility and industrial applications, today reported financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 and outlined a framework designed to support sustainable growth and value creation.

 

“Higher third quarter sales and continued backlog growth reflect the demand for our services and our progress in converting promising opportunities into new awards,” said Ramesh Nuggihalli, President and Chief Executive Officer. “This momentum underscores the relevance of our technology portfolio to customers’ evolving environmental and operational priorities and improves our visibility into future performance. Our strong financial position provides the resources and flexibility to drive long-term our growth.”

 

He continued, “Since joining Fuel Tech in August, I have developed a strong appreciation for the quality of our people, the breadth and value of our technology portfolio, our global reach and the attractive markets we serve. Our focus now is to convert these strengths into sustainable, above-market growth. We intend to pursue organic growth initiatives by deepening Fuel Tech’s presence in our core markets and pursuing burgeoning power infrastructure opportunities that support data center and AI infrastructure construction, as well as water and wastewater treatment. We are also focused on select M&A through a holistic, bottom-up strategy which identifies opportunities that strengthen our product portfolio and expand our channel presence.

 

“This is an active and ongoing process that will take time to fully implement, but the direction is clear. We are aligning our resources behind the opportunities where Fuel Tech can create the greatest value while establishing the strategic priorities and operating disciplines needed to drive more consistent financial performance and sustainable long-term value for our shareholders.”

 

Third Quarter 2026 (“Q3 2026”) Results Overview

All comparisons are to the third quarter ended September 30, 2025 unless otherwise stated.

 

Consolidated revenues for Q3 2026 rose 16% to $8.7 million from $7.5 million, driven by a 38% increase in revenues at the Company’s Air Pollution Control (“APC”) segment attributable to a significantly higher backlog during 2026 and progress on existing contracts. FUEL CHEM segment revenues rose by 3%.

 

Consolidated gross margin for Q3 2026 declined to 45% of revenues from 49% of revenues. APC gross margin declined to 40% from 47% due to changes in project and product mix. FUEL CHEM gross margin was 49% compared to 50%.

 

 
 

 

SG&A expenses for Q3 2026 were $3.7 million, or 42% of revenues, compared to $3.2 million, or 43% of revenues, reflecting higher employee related costs and professional fees, including a non-recurring expense of approximately $175,000 related to the CEO transition.

 

Interest income for Q3 2026 was $247,000 compared to $311,000.

 

Net loss in Q3 2026 was $(267,000), or $(0.01) per share, compared to net income of $303,000, or $0.01 per share.

 

Adjusted EBITDA loss was $(249,000) in Q3 2026 compared to an Adjusted EBITDA of $228,000.

 

Consolidated APC segment backlog at September 30, 2026 was $16.6 million compared to $14.3 million at June 30, 2026 and $7.0 million at December 31, 2025. Backlog at September 30, 2026 did not include the recently awarded APC contracts valued at $3.3 million.

 

Financial Condition

 

As of September 30, 2026, cash and cash equivalents were $6.8 million, short-term investments were $11.0 million, and long-term investments totaled $10.0 million. Stockholders’ equity as of September 30, 2026 was $37.2 million, or $1.19 per share, and the Company had no debt.

About Fuel Tech

 

Fuel Tech develops and commercializes state-of-the-art proprietary technologies for air pollution control, process optimization, water treatment, and advanced engineering services. These technologies enable customers to operate in a cost-effective and environmentally sustainable manner. Fuel Tech is a leader in nitrogen oxide (NOx) reduction and particulate control technologies, and its solutions have been installed on over 2,100 utility, industrial and municipal units worldwide. The Company’s chemical technologies improve the efficiency, reliability, fuel flexibility, boiler heat rate, and environmental status of combustion units by controlling slagging, fouling, corrosion and opacity. This includes Fuel Tech’s advanced TIFI® Targeted In-Furnace Injection™ technology which offers an innovative solution to fireside treatment on boilers using coal, oil or biomass. Water treatment technologies include DGI® Dissolved Gas Infusion Systems which utilize a patented saturator and a patent-pending channel injector to deliver supersaturated oxygen solutions and other gas-water combinations to target process applications or environmental issues. This infusion process has a variety of applications in the water and wastewater industries, including remediation, aeration, biological treatment and wastewater odor management. Many of Fuel Tech’s products and services rely heavily on the Company’s exceptional Computational Fluid Dynamics modeling capabilities, which are enhanced by internally developed, high-end visualization software. For more information, visit Fuel Tech’s web site at ftek.com.

Adjusted EBITDA

 

To supplement the Company's consolidated financial statements presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (GAAP), the Company has provided an Adjusted EBITDA disclosure as a measure of financial performance. Adjusted EBITDA is defined as net income (loss) before interest expense, income tax expense (benefit), depreciation expense, amortization expense, and stock compensation expense. The Company's reference to these non-GAAP measures should be considered in addition to results prepared in accordance with GAAP standards, but are not a substitute for, or superior to, GAAP results.

 

Adjusted EBITDA is provided to enhance investors' overall understanding of the Company's current financial performance and ability to generate cash flow, which we believe is a meaningful measure for our investor and analyst communities. In many cases non-GAAP financial measures are utilized by these individuals to evaluate Company performance and ultimately determine a reasonable valuation for our common stock. A reconciliation of Adjusted EBITDA to the nearest GAAP measure of net income (loss) has been included in the above financial table.
